name: me-qr-dynamic-qr-generator
description: Create and manage dynamic ME-QR codes for links, contacts, email, text, PDFs, and image galleries.

interface.longDescription: Create dynamic QR codes in ChatGPT for links, digital business cards, email, text, PDFs, and image galleries. Scanning a contact QR opens an ME-QR web page with the corresponding details. Customize colors, shapes, and logos in the interactive widget, then download the QR code. Wi-Fi QR codes are created on the ME-QR website: https://me-qr.com/qr-code-generator/wi-fi.
defaultPrompt: Create a QR code for https://me-qr.com
Create a business card QR code

positive.description: Create a dynamic QR code linking to a URL
positive.prompt: Create a QR code for https://me-qr.com
positive.expected_behavior: create_qr_link creates a dynamic QR for https://me-qr.com and displays a scannable QR in the ChatGPT widget. Scanning opens the ME-QR redirect and reaches the requested destination. The QR page and customization actions are available.

positive.description: Create a dynamic digital business card QR code
positive.prompt: Create a business card QR code for John Doe, phone +1 234 567 890, email john@example.com, company Acme Inc
positive.expected_behavior: create_qr_vcard creates a dynamic QR and displays it in the ChatGPT widget. The QR encodes an ME-QR HTTPS URL, not a raw vCard payload. Scanning opens an ME-QR contact page showing John Doe, phone +1234567890 (or an equivalent format), email john@example.com, and company Acme Inc.

positive.description: Create a QR code and change its color to red
positive.prompt: Create a QR code for https://me-qr.com, then change its color to red
positive.expected_behavior: In the same conversation turn, create_qr_link creates the QR and customize_qr uses its returned ID to change the visible QR color to red. The final QR remains scannable and reaches https://me-qr.com.

positive.description: Create a QR code and update its destination
positive.prompt: Create a QR code for https://me-qr.com, then change it to point to https://example.com
positive.expected_behavior: In the same conversation turn, create_qr_link creates the QR and update_qr_link uses the returned ID to change its destination to https://example.com. The QR keeps the same ID, and scanning it reaches the new destination.

positive.description: Wi-Fi QR is not created in ChatGPT; return the ME-QR website link
positive.prompt: Create a Wi-Fi QR code for my home network
positive.expected_behavior: get_wifi_qr_website_link returns websiteUrl https://me-qr.com/qr-code-generator/wi-fi. The assistant shows that exact URL, does not ask for SSID/password/encryption, and does not call create/update/customize tools.

negative.description: Reading an existing QR image is unsupported; ME-QR should not be invoked.
negative.prompt: What does this QR code say? [uploads a photo of a QR code]

negative.description: A general explanation of QR codes does not require ME-QR tools.
negative.prompt: What is a QR code and how does it work?

negative.description: Generating a barcode is unsupported; ME-QR should not be invoked.
negative.prompt: Generate a barcode for product SKU 12345

publication.release_notes: Improved privacy protections and authentication. Wi-Fi QR requests now direct users to the ME-QR website. Updated the privacy notice URL for the ChatGPT integration.
